_comment: Expected equilibrium ranges for the reference LJ-argon NVT case (rho*=0.8442, T*=1.5, fcc 5x5x5 = 500 atoms, fixed velocity seed). Derived from a real lmp_serial run (2nd-half average over 2000 steps). The temperature ~ thermostat setpoint (1.5) is the robust NVT check; pressure/energy bands tolerate solver-build variation.
